responsibility: This file adapts diagnostics emitted by the shared D frontend to GCC’s diagnostic subsystem. It rewrites DMD-style format strings into forms accepted by GCC pretty-printers, maps D source `Loc` objects to rich GCC locations, and implements the frontend’s error, warning, deprecation, note, message, tip, and fatal-reporting entry points while updating D global error/warning/gag accounting and respecting options such as `-Wdeprecated` and warning-as-error behavior.
